title: Midnight on Bleecker
style: 50s jazz swing with a brisk 4/4 walking upright bass, brushed snare, ride cymbal ping, muted trumpet replies, tenor sax flourishes, and close-harmony vocals in English, Portuguese, French, and Italian; verse rides bright piano comping and intimate lead lines, pre-chorus thins to bass and brushes, chorus opens with stacked harmonies and call-and-response punches. Tape warmth, room reverb, little horn fills between phrases, raw New York club mix with smoky mids and crisp cymbal air., swing, vocal, jazz, harmony, bright, raw, uptempo
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I came in late with the rain on my coat
Your red dress caught the room by the throat
The bass kept time like a patient hand
And your laugh slid low through the band

Você sorriu, I lost my place
Across the room, that perfect face
The trumpet said, "come here, come near"
And the whole damn table leaned to hear

[Pre-Chorus]
Dim lights, fast heart
Wine glass, drum brush start
Je te vois, mon cœur
Say my name, make it blur

[Chorus]
Sway with me, mio amore
Stay with me, one more encore
Vamos dançar, mon cher
Sway with me, stay right there

Sway with me, meu bem
Say it again and again
Vieni qui, mon amour
Sway with me, one more encore

[Verse 2]
The sax got rough with a velvet cry
Your hands went up like a wing in the sky
I said, "baby, don't let this stop"
You said, "dance first, talk after the drop"

A piano grin on the backbeat rose
Ash in the tray and a line of close
We spun too quick for the barroom floor
Then the band hit hard and you begged for more

[Pre-Chorus]
Brass takes the turn
My knees still burn
Je t'entends rire
Pull me in, pull me higher

[Chorus]
Sway with me, mio amore
Stay with me, one more encore
Vamos dançar, mon cher
Sway with me, stay right there

Sway with me, meu bem
Say it again and again
Vieni qui, mon amour
Sway with me, one more encore

[Bridge]
Tu m’as trouvé
By the window’s glow
Mi corazón
Won't let you go
La nuit is wide
But we fit like that
One sweet turn
And I'm coming back

[Final Chorus]
Sway with me, mio amore
Stay with me, one more encore
Vamos dançar, mon cher
Sway with me, stay right there

Sway with me, meu bem
Say it again and again
Vieni qui, mon amour
Sway with me, one more encore
